statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes used are I49.9 and I48.0
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
